feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cows also have access to chopped corn silage and grains such as beans, corn kernels along with vitamins and minerals.

resold_note: Also sells eggs from hens kept on a different farm, contract-raised chicken, and products from other local family farms.
notes: Bodine Farms Meat Market in Hartly, DE; store open Monday, Wednesday and Friday 1 to 5 pm and Saturday 10 am to 3 pm, with online orders for in-store pickup or Wednesday evening delivery up to 20 miles from the farm (fee by distance). Site says it does not ship. Checked 2026-11-15 the home, about the farm, shop, bulk beef, livestock CSA and shipping and delivery pages. Site describes the meat as pasture raised; the about page says cows have year-round access to hay plus corn silage and grains, and pigs have pasture and hay plus grains, so the category is percentage. Bulk beef (whole, half, quarter) and bulk pork were out of stock on 2026-11-15 while retail pork cuts were in stock. A livestock CSA page exists but gives no readable contents or prices. The shop lists lamb shanks and legs, but no page says where the lamb is raised, so lamb is left out. Egg hens are on a different farm and meat chickens are contract-raised for an integrator (see resold_note).
